fields.description: Program Description Training Objectives The undergraduate major in supply chain management (international students) cultivates students who meet the needs of economic development, have a comprehensive development of morality, intelligence, physique, and aesthetics, have a high ideological and cultural cultivation, have a good innovative spirit and practical ability, have a solid foundation in foreign languages, mathematics, computer science, and a solid theoretical foundation in economics, management, information, systems science, and related disciplines, are familiar with policies and regulations in logistics and related industries, and master systematic circulation Theoretical knowledge of supply chain and supply chain management, capable of engaging in the operation and management of logistics enterprises, as well as the operation and management of cross-border logistics businesses in circulation and production enterprises. Professional core courses Serial Number Course No Course name credit Credit hours 1 ITIN013_ 20T Logistics 2 32 2 LOMN022_ 20K International Freight and Forwarding 2 32 3 ITIN028_ 20T Logistics Space (International) 2 32 4 ITIN023_ 20T Warehousing and Inventory Management (International) 2 32 5 ITIN026_ 20T Operation Management (Bilingual) (International) 2 32 6 ITIN022_ 20T Distribution Center Planning and Design (International) 2 32 7 ITIN027_ 20T Logistics Management Information System (International) 2 32 8 ITIN025_ 20T Supply Chain Management (International) 2 32 9 ITIN046_ 20T E-commerce and Logistics (International) 2 32 10 PRMN006_ 20K Supplier Management 2 32

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Certification of no criminal record 4. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. High school academic transcript * 6. Financial support statement There are 30,000 to 50,000 RMB in the bank account, and relatives' bank accounts need to be explained. 7. Certificate of Medical Examination For long-term only 8. Personal Statement Documents in RAR, PDF, JPG, PNG, GIF, DOC and DOCX format are accepted. * 9. Language Proficiency Certificate HSK 5 or above for Chinese medium programs; IELTs or TOEFL for English Medium programs. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Non-Chinese citizens with high school education or above (equivalent to the sixth grade of middle school education) and holding ordinary foreign passports valid for more than 12 months. Be in good health, be of good character with no criminal record, abide by Chinese government laws and school rules and regulations, and respect the customs of the Chinese people.
